findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "util" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: convert_data, validate_identifier, parse_phone_number, lookup_phone_prefix, parse_url, get_public_holidays, count_or_add_business_days, convert_color_check_contrast, check_wcag_contrast, make_qr_code, make_barcode, read_qr_barcode, peppol_lookup, lint_x402_listing, build_ics_event, parse_ics, expand_rrule, decode_jwt, verify_jwt, get_gpu_prices, get_gpu_price_index, upload_file_get_link, lookup_barcode_product · Private data: text_encode, generate_random, validate_json, convert_data, parse_url, convert_time, peppol_lookup, build_ics_event, parse_ics, decode_jwt, verify_jwt, decode_lightning_invoice, decode_nostr_id, upload_file_get_link, render_mermaid · Public sink: hash_text, hmac_sign_verify, build_ics_event, verify_jwt, upload_file_get_link · Destructive: validate_identifier, parse_phone_number, cron_next_runs, render_mermaid.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
